claim: At revision 469ce77a07b988c49deb930632b8276c89ec6b66, six README C++ blocks (the Quick Start and five Additional Examples) that call pres.slides()[0] fail to compile with g++ 13.5.0 (invalid use of incomplete type 'class Aspose::Slides::Foss::Slide') because none of them includes <Aspose/Slides/Foss/slide.h>.
suggested_issue_title: Aspose.Slides FOSS for Cpp: README C++ examples do not compile, <Aspose/Slides/Foss/slide.h> is not included
suggested_issue_body:
Reproduced independently against the current default-branch head `469ce77a07b988c49deb930632b8276c89ec6b66` on 2026-10-10.

## Summary

Six of the README's C++ examples (the Quick Start at `README.md:241` and the Additional Examples at `:284`, `:315`, `:341`, `:367` and `:393`) call `pres.slides()[0]` and then use the returned `Slide`. None of them includes `<Aspose/Slides/Foss/slide.h>`, so `Slide` is only forward-declared at that point and the code does not compile.

## Environment

- Revision `469ce77a07b988c49deb930632b8276c89ec6b66` (default branch `main`)
- g++ 13.5.0 (Docker image `gcc:13`), `-std=c++20`, libpugixml-dev 1.13 for the pugixml headers

## Steps to reproduce

Put the Quick Start block (`README.md:242-260`) in `quickstart.cpp` (it already has `int main()`), then:

```sh
g++ -std=c++20 -fsyntax-only -Iinclude quickstart.cpp
```

The five Additional Examples need the same treatment (wrapped in `int main() { ... }`) and fail the same way.

## Expected

The Quick Start and the Additional Examples compile as written.

## Actual result

```
quickstart.cpp:14:19: error: invalid use of incomplete type 'class Aspose::Slides::Foss::Slide'
```

Adding `#include <Aspose/Slides/Foss/slide.h>` to the Quick Start makes it compile (exit 0).

## Where in the repository

- `README.md:241`, `:284`, `:315`, `:341`, `:367`, `:393`

## Suggested fix

Add `#include <Aspose/Slides/Foss/slide.h>` (and any other header each example uses) to these blocks, or provide and use an umbrella header.
